message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel line chart comparing reward and token length for Solve and Propose across training steps.","description":"A two-panel line chart with Training Steps on both horizontal axes and a legend identifying Solve (purple) and Propose (coral). The left panel plots Reward, with a vertical scale from 0 to 1. Solve rises rapidly from near zero to about 0.75 around step 60, then generally declines and fluctuates around 0.4–0.6 through roughly step 180; afterward it is highly volatile, with peaks near 0.8 and 0.96 and sharp dips. Propose rises more gradually from zero to around 0.4–0.5 by about step 170, then fluctuates sharply, including late peaks and drops. The right panel plots Token Length against the right-hand vertical axis, whose printed ticks run from 400 to 1400. Solve starts near 380, falls early, has a brief spike around step 70, then climbs overall; it levels around 700 in the middle before rising steeply to about 1340 at the end. Propose starts near 700, briefly peaks around 780, falls to roughly 300, spikes near 800 around step 65 and drops again, then mostly fluctuates around 300–400, with a late dip and recovery. Values below are estimated from the plotted lines at the labeled training-step ticks where data is present; the curves end at approximately step
